info.name: ERPify API
info.description:
ERPify HTTP API (Symfony 8 on FrankenPHP).

**Development environment:** `base_url = https://localhost` (primary checkout, fixed ports 80/443). The dev TLS certificate is local: disable *SSL certificate verification* in Postman (Settings → General) or trust Caddy's local CA.

- All responses are JSON; errors follow RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).
- Routes live under `/api/v1` (frontoffice/shared) and `/api/v1/backoffice` (backoffice).
- Folders mirror the bounded contexts under `api/src/` (Backoffice, Frontoffice, Shared).

variable.description: Base URL of the development stack (FrankenPHP, primary checkout)

request.description: Liveness check for the backoffice context. Requires an authenticated session: it is not exempt from the firewall, and answers 401 Problem Details without one. Use the Frontoffice health request for an unauthenticated probe.

Database reachability probe (SELECT 1). Requires an authenticated session. Returns data.status 'ok' when the database responds, 'error' otherwise; HTTP 200 either way — the status code reports whether the request could be decided, data.status reports what the probe found.

query.description: Opaque cursor for cursor-based pagination (mutually exclusive with page)
Generic filter: public field name (allow-listed for banks: name, id)
eq | in | contains (strictly lowercase); id allows only eq/in

Scalar value for eq/contains (max 255 chars); for in use filters[0][value][] (repeatable, max 100 values). Max 20 filters, indexes contiguous from 0; effective wire limit is min(caps, max_input_vars=1000, URL length)

request.description: Paginated bank search. Serialization groups: identifiable, timestamped, bank:search. Generic filters[N][field|operator|value] grammar documented in api/docs/adding-endpoints.md.
Bank detail by UUID. 404 (application/problem+json) when it does not exist.
Creates a bank. `name` ≤ 255 chars, `shortName` ≤ 50 chars; both required. 201 on creation, 400 with violations on validation failure. Accepts JSON or form.
Updates a bank. Same validation rules as the POST.
Deletes a bank by UUID (hard delete).
Returns 204 and sets the Mercure authorization cookie for the bank topics (collection + detail).

item.name: Identity & recovery
item.description: The self-service credential surface and the anonymous lockout edge. Sign in FIRST: the three /me requests carry no token of their own — the session is an httpOnly cookie the login response sets, and Postman's cookie jar replays it. Only the redemption is reachable without one. Passwords are left blank on purpose; fill them from your own stack and never commit one.

request.description: 204 with the session cookie. Present so the three /me requests below can be run at all — without it they answer 401 and the folder documents a surface nobody can exercise.
Whether the caller holds one, and the two instants that bound it — never the secret itself. The plaintext is legible exactly once, in the mint response.

201 whose body is the ONLY place the plaintext ever appears. Re-proves the current password on the per-identity budget shared with the password change and the revoke. 409 recovery-secret-already-exists when one is already held; 403 invalid-current-password on a wrong one; 429 rate-limited when the shared budget is spent.

POST rather than DELETE because the password must travel in a body: every request header but Referer reaches the container access log in clear. Idempotent 204 whether or not a row was there, and the credential proof fires before existence is consulted so the response shape is not an oracle over whether a secret exists.

The one edge a locked-out sole administrator has. No session needed; same-origin is enforced and the stateless CSRF token must be present and well-formed. EVERY refusal answers one byte-identical 400 invalid-token — malformed, unknown selector, wrong secret, lapsed, budget spent — because a graded answer would tell a caller which selectors exist and are worth draining.
Liveness check for the frontoffice context, and the only health route outside the firewall — reachable with no session, which is what the deploy smoke test and the public /status page rely on.
FrankenPHP hot-reload endpoint. Only available in dev.

item.name: Shared
item.description: Capability modules of the shared kernel that publish a route

item.name: Images
item.description: Shared/Images read surface — canonical bytes addressed by identity alone

header.description: Optional. Echo a previous response's ETag to get a 304 instead of the body. The strong ("<digest>"), weak (W/"<digest>") and unquoted forms are all accepted, as is *.

variable.description: Image UUID v7. Case-insensitive: the module normalises it.

request.description: Canonical bytes of an image, addressed by identity alone. Requires a session like the rest of /api (401 without one, decided before anything is resolved) and grants nothing beyond it: any authenticated caller may read any image, because the module holds no owner. 200 carries the row's own Content-Type, a strong ETag derived from the digest, and Cache-Control: private, max-age=3600, immutable. 304 when If-None-Match still matches AND the object is still retrievable. 400 invalid-uuid for a malformed identifier; 404 not-found for an absent row or absent bytes; 503 service-unavailable for a retryable storage failure. Range is ignored (always the full body, never 206/416) and neither Accept-Ranges nor Last-Modified is emitted.
